title: Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an…
description: A type confusion vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. The flaw involves accessing a resource using an incompatible type, potentially leading to privilege escalation. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.4. No affected versions or patch information are currently provided.
